limitations: Only 16 independent deals per head-to-head cell; modest differences will remain uncertain.
One frozen checkpoint per learned version; intervals cover deal variation, not training-seed variation.
Training datasets, objectives, and feature families differ across versions; this is not a controlled parameter-count scaling experiment.
Production automatic flip depth changes between 25 and 100 ms; these are practical budget comparisons rather than a fixed-search-policy intervention.
Wall-clock budgets run concurrently on one host. Record observed move times, nodes, and depths; some scheduling noise remains.
All time contrasts share deals, but each model pair uses a different deal block. Anchor model comparisons also use different blocks.
A small exploratory tournament does not replace the earlier independent, larger confirmation studies or establish a universal strongest engine.
